exposure: Caesarean delivery in the second stage of labor
cohort: 388 women who underwent emergency cesarean delivery
finding: Women who underwent cesarean delivery in the second stage of labor had significantly higher blood loss, longer hospital stays, and longer operation times compared to those who underwent cesarean delivery in the first stage.
mod_finding: Women who underwent cesarean delivery in the second stage of labor had higher rates of caesarean hysterectomy and extension of the incision site compared to those who had a cesarean in the first stage.
